notes.title: Winter Sale & Mixed Reviews
notes.content:
Feedback has been pretty clear since the last update, so we've added new features and QoL improvements to reflect it. While we know many of you were looking forward to a Christmas Event, stabilizing the game is crucial before we can resume title updates. We are a small 2 person team, simultaneously working on, Faulty Apprentice: Best Elf, so please bear with us.

Regardless of previous issues, we've had many of you support us through microtransactions, making last month one of our best months yet! We know that microtransactions can be a sensitive topic for some people, but the players that use them allow us to continue making the free title updates we all enjoy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/8d62111cdc737318d0e4bd9933d7aacbb1829964.gif[/img]

[b]Girls Menu[/b]
Girls are the main focus of Girls Overboard, so we revamped the Girls Menu to reflect that!
-NEW! Outfits previews and filtering.
-NEW! Character Bios/info have been added
-Gallery section has been merged into Girls Menu


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/b4e710fdde8373eb4066f54fcca15415435ffee4.gif[/img]

[b]New Outfit Bonus System and Idle Progress[/b]
Wouldn't it be great if you could do nothing and get something? Well, now you can! The old system of selling gems for sand dollars was missed by players, so we added a new way to earn goodies, even while AFK!
-NEW! Outfits collected add towards a cumulative bonus based on number of stars of each outfit collected, regardless of which outfit is equipped. Now, girls can wear whatever and you still get a bonus!
-Base stamina regeneration has been buffed since outfits no longer buff stamina. You will earn water bottles instead. Lust reward in Slot Machine was also buffed to reflect this change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/8a1147d2f004a3e2d201b89374e1e027dfd5df13.gif[/img]

[b]Swapping Girls, Better Bubbles and Infinity +1[/b]
Some ideas sound good on paper, but lose their luster when you see how it affects real folks. *Name that Christmas movie line!
-NEW! Ability to swap girls freely and force timeout. It's practically a swingers party!
-NEW! Endless mode (Saphyria) allows you to farm lust, the higher stages you reach the more lust you get. This stage doesn't consume any currency and it's all about rushing against the timer. So, finishing quick with a girl is a good thing for once!
-NEW! Mouse support for Bubble Shooter. Good luck precision shooters!
-Character scenes no longer trigger immediately. A "Click Me" will appear on the girl's sprite when a new scene is unlocked. So, make sure your door is locked before you click them!
-Results screen will trigger when you finish a girl's stage and offer tips if you failed. No, not tips in bed, tips how to clear the stage! 
-Cosmetic loot amounts increase with higher heart counts. More = more!


[b]Shop Talk[/b]
-Pearl Amounts rebalanced with the Idle Bonuses added *All previous Pearls owned will be balanced according and a little extra as thank you for your support!
-Winter sale! 20% MORE Pearls during the Winter Sale!

Major bug fixes:
Some characters not always unlocking as the requirement.

We tend to get feedback only when things go wrong so please don't hesitate to post on forum, join our discord and review the game to tell us what you like about it Thank you for playing!
-Din

notes.title: Title Update 5: New Gameplay, New Character!
notes.content:
For the past few months we've been listening to you, the player's feedback. Both good and bad. Your opinion means a lot to us, so we have been working between Free Title Updates on creating an entirely new gameplay experience. We referenced games you suggested as well as added our own touch to set Girls Overboard apart. We hope you enjoy!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/c313a6f650497c63402bef27860cb96bc080e788.jpg[/img]

[b]Eleanna from Faulty Apprentice is here![/b]
Eleanna is a Sailing Instructor looking for an apprentice willing to learn, and most importantly, not a pervert. If you can keep your pants on, learning to sail should be a breeze. There's no way you would end up in international waters with her tied up and unconscious, right?

Whether you're a Stars Reach veteran or have never played our flagship game, Faulty Apprentice, you are in for an exciting experience with the newest addition to Girls Overboard, Eleanna! She's also the star of our upcoming game, Best Elf! Now available to wishlist on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1583240
https://store.steampowered.com/app/630550

[b]New Bubble Shooter![/b]
Prevent girls from overwhelming you with their sexuality by shooting gems of the same color as they descend and destroying them. Destroying gems and using Lust will determine how quickly your relationships increase or if you will fail in miserable loneliness.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/46f8525f7aa7bebc02ec11dee494a6c6f4fa33fd.png[/img]

[b]New Relationship System and other mechanics[/b]
[list]
[*] Hearts <3 Unlock Hearts and story scenes for each girl by filling their Relationship Bar via the Bubble Shooter. Failing to clear character stages in time will reset the progress, so don't miss your chance to shoot your shot! 
[*] Lust! Gems, Gifts, and Dust have been streamlined into a single currency, Lust! Lust points can be used to increase the speed at which Relationships increase. The more you Lust, the more you bust! 
[*] Look! I mean, Loot! The Fashion Boutique is now optional loot that spawns when you successfully win a girl's Heart. Like real clothes though, you get what you pay for!
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/614dfd4e10f5ffa493680724926af1cc2f5d620e.jpg[/img]

Body Writing Outfit Bundle 2!
Enjoy the popular Body Writing outfits for all the new girls, Talia, Madison, Ashera, and Eleanna! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/215e6733fdcf161844a7ad761ab664637579bfea.jpg[/img]

If the other outfits aren't lewd enough for you, then this one should do the trick. Make Eleanna your personal maid, sit and wait for your entrance as king of her castle!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/2845909e5064a7d4d07beddc0296a1218ce55e62.jpg[/img]

Merry Christmas! Get in the Christmas spirit by getting all eleven girls into sexy Christmas outfits! 


While we are pretty happy with the direction of the game, we will continue to keep an eye on the progression numbers and player feedback to smoothen the new experience. So, don't be shy to reach out to us on [url=https://discord.gg/aglstudioart]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/AGLstudioArt]Twitter[/url] or right here on Steam. We appreciate you playing our games and want to give you the most enjoyable experience possible! 

Thank you for playing Girls Overboard. (= 
-Din

[h2][u][b]Good- Great- Grand- WONDERFUL NEWS!!![/b][/u] [/h2]
We've FINALLY passed the Steam review process and have a new release date!! But be sure to read this entire post because we have other important information to share with you.

[h3]💦 June 1st, 2022 | 3pm PST 💦[/h3]

[h2][b][u]Pricing Changes to SFW + NSFW Versions:[/u] [/b][/h2]
In order to get the SFW version of GO approved on Steam, we had to remove all sexy content, and since we are going in a more sexy direction with our games in general, it turned out there was a LOT of sexy content! They even had us remove audio soundbites. While the SFW version of GO is still a relaxing match-3 game, the true experience lies in the 18+ Wet 'n' Wild version. Therefore we have decided to change our pricing model:

[list]
[*] [b]Girls Overboard Base Game[/b] = $1.99
[*] [b]Girls Overboard Wet 'n' Wild Patch[/b] = FREE!
[/list]
We are making this pricing change in order to encourage players to play the Wet 'n' Wild version.

[h2][u][b]Newsletter Incoming![/b][/u] [/h2]
You never know when our tech overlords are going to crack down on sexy content and ban us, so to keep in touch we will be starting a bi-weekly email newsletter in the near future. I want you on that list! 
Emails will include [b]news[/b], [b]reward codes[/b], [b]exclusive art[/b], and other [b]goodies[/b]! Like this [b]NSFW wallpaper pack[/b]!

-Din

notes.title: Girls Overboard is Delayed
notes.content:
[i]"How do you make God laugh? …Tell him your plans."[/i] - John Cleese

Even though this is only our 2nd game release, we really thought we could do it. [b]Despite a major setback[/b] that caused us to lose an entire week of development time, [b][u]we didn't give up[/u][/b] but instead pulled some all-nighters (mainly our programmer, Bam. He really pulled through) and [b][u]WE FINISHED THE GAME[/u]![/b]

Then came the Steam review process... Since [b][u]we did everything on our end to comply with Steam's terms[/u] (NSFW Rules)[/b], we had hoped we would be approved. We even based the review time on an earlier review and made plans to have time to submit again if needed. This is why we decided to move forward with the original launch timeline. However, the [b][u]review time by Steam took much longer than previously[/u] [/b]and we lost all that extra submission time.

[b][u]It was a gamble waiting for approval[/u] [/b]until the actual day of launch, but the last thing I wanted to do was write this. [b][u]As team leader (Din), I take full responsibility for the delay and sincerely apologize.[/u][/b] My team has done everything on our end possible to meet today's deadline, [b][u]but now it is in the hands of the Steam Review team.[/u][/b]

We do not have an exact timeframe [b][u](hopefully next week!)[/u][/b] on getting approved by Steam Review. [b][u]As soon as we have any new information[/u], I will share it on [url=https://discord.gg/AGLstudioArt][u]Discord[/u][/url] and here[/b]. Please know we are doing everything within our power to get you to Kawaii Island so you can romance those beautiful babes! 💦


In the meantime, thankfully, we can finally show off the full thing for everyone to see – 
[h2]Check out the full version of the launch video on our YouTube channel ☀️[/h2]
At the link below:
 [previewyoutube=-opyRLyi5zg;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for your patience. Again,[b] [u]this is my fault and I apologize[/u][/b]. I want to make an awesome game for you and I want to release it! 

-Din

notes.content:

[h3]using pearls will be [b][u]OPTIONAL[/u][/b]. [/h3]

All content will be available on[b] [u]itchio[/u][/b] and our [url=AGLstudioArt.com][b][u]website[/u]![/b][/url] Whether you want to buy the game [u]DRM free[/u] or just get the [u]NSFW patch[/u] from outside of Steam, we will have you covered. Look forward to specific details in a future post!

notes.title: Girls Overboard Development Update & Release Window!
notes.content:
Ahoy! It's been a long time in development and we apologize for the delay, but were ready to give you a huge update regarding Girls Overboard's progress! 

Our team has been working extremely hard and we have tons of information to share about the current game status and our projected release window!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/b2744f498bd7d6ecb354785f5880d088406df52a.png[/img]

[i]The following post contains information for all fans of Girls Overboard so please read the post in full![/i]

[u][h2]Writing & Programming Departments[/h2] [/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/98baf0ac141328c744b9bc29bffad4fbb22f7248.jpg[/img]
We are happy to report our creator/writer, Dinmoney has completed the story scripts for all seven characters included at launch, and they have all been proofread by our editor, Ronove. Not only that, but we have already written and reviewed the first four DLC character scripts (post-release)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/7990aab3282b2a999fd8e452816eaf45d065c78d.jpg[/img]
Regarding the coding side of development, our programmer, BamBam has finished all the primary dating and gameplay systems and are entering the final phase of testing. The only things left are finalizing the SFW / NSFW versions to comply with the Steam review process. Once approved by Steam we can finish the in-app purchase system!


[h2][u]Voice Acting & Audio Departments[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/d935a21e2d6c36edd9b5250c066fbd995f8bb73f.jpg[/img]
Thanks to our talented voice cast we are pleased to report all the voice acting work is completely finished! We'd also like to thank our casting department and audio team, Jesika, for finding such a wonderful voice cast and balancing all the audio files.

[h2][u]Art Department[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/ae787cecb86a86ac5ea6ddbab3a129300c84e187.jpg[/img]
Our art team has been working hard to make Girls Overboard jam-packed with beautiful animated artwork! At launch, there will be 30 animated Scene Images (CGs), and over 140 different outfits to choose from. We also already have additional girls planned as DLC coming post-launch!

[i]*Due to Steam's policy on nudity, we cannot show the full extent of animated story scenes. However, you can get an idea of the art quality!*[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/84e769c4f72c004a4b4a8e9f8d1d9200324efcf0.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/661e1ecdc06c2efb5eb7580cd579725f35093f91.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/091f54b2f93b4910184cd4873e845d8de01d20a5.jpg[/img]
All the in-game artwork is completed! Each story scene will reflect the relationship status and escalate towards a climax (literally and figuratively). We are just putting User Interface at 90% because we may add visual effects, resize or tweak some menus based on final testing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/d8466a4a05f9cb3cfefefb9ca194e0636ebc2eec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/6173554bfa9f547aec2f59fcd8c7784ab5f52271.png[/img]
We have tons of different outfits that will not only give a variety of appearances to your favorite girls but depending on their rarity will also give you a stamina regeneration bonus. Five Star outfits will be 18+ and only available in the Wet 'n' Wild DLC patch of Girls Overboard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38710842/363d913ee96855a1f67fa8941e893afb209d85b8.jpg[/img]
There are already several girls lined up to join the datable roster of Girls Overboard as post-launch DLC. Some are native to Kawaii while some are familiar faces from far-off places!

[u][h2]Release Window[/h2][/u]
Girls Overboard development has taken longer than we originally planned, but the main reason for that was the decision to completely revamp the core gameplay into a Match-3 game. This was a decision we hope you will understand as it has made Girls Overboard more enjoyable to play. If you played the first demo, we're sure you will agree!

After careful consideration of the amount of work left to do, we have decided on a [b]release date window of April 5th - April 15th, 2022[/b]. This will give us enough time to finalize the remaining tasks and pass the Steam review process.

We will be releasing another update between [b]March 14th - March 18th, 2022[/b] that will include a new trailer, and the exact release date.

[u][h2]Game Information and Pricing[/h2][/u]
At launch, Girls Overboard will be available only on Steam for PC. 
After release, we will work on making GO available via our website and other platforms. As well as localization/translations and a Mac version if possible.

The SFW version of Girls Overboard will be FREE to play. The 18+ Wet 'n' Wild version will be available as a DLC patch for only $1.99.

[h2][u]Closing Note[/u][/h2]
We hope that everyone is excited for their Kawaii vacation and we ask for your patience just a little longer as we finish development. Thank you for supporting a new studio like us. We look forward to sharing a bright future of games with you and we'll be back with another update next week!

If you have any questions, please email us at [u]AGLstudioArt@gmail.com[/u] or join our discord: [url=https://discord.gg/AGLstudioArt]https://discord.gg/AGLstudioArt[/url]
